scope.goal: Repair the decision/fallback path so safe automation remains useful, risky requests receive specific handoff questions, and end users do not see internal diagnostics.
forbiddenFiles: all Verify page, policy page, header, review/audit page files
notes: All behavior changes live in the allowed files only. policy.ts was intentionally NOT modified: the FAIL-branch question enrichment happens in the service layer (services/support.ts) using the preserved deterministic canonical, while adminReason keeps raw rule text for reviewers.
No ground truth, fixture expected outputs or Verify case compositions were changed.

investigation.method: Deterministic local model fault injection (x-support-model-simulation header / ModelOptions.fault) against base 542d042; no production requests were made by the AI.
findings: CONFIRMED on base: routine VPN input with invalid/unavailable model output escalates FAIL-002/FAIL-001 with only the generic handoff question 'Xác nhận phạm vi và người có thẩm quyền xử lý.' — the preserved deterministic intent (VPN_NOT_CONNECTING) is not used by the questions.
CONFIRMED on base: risky public-port (9443/3389) inputs keep SEC-002 with concrete questions even under fault (deterministic risk pre-empts the model). Left unchanged.
CONFIRMED on base: authority inputs (production admin) keep AUTH-002/AUTH-003 with owner/approval questions even under fault. Left unchanged.
CONFIRMED on base: missing-info inputs ask up to 3 clarification questions; the brief requires the single most decision-relevant field.
CONFIRMED on base: FAIL escalation userReason exposes engine wording ('Model trả dữ liệu không đúng schema...') to requesters; the reviewer-only details show raw bucket IDs.
NOT REPRODUCED in 542d042: the generic-question observations reported on deployed SHA 01a20a7 exist in 542d042 only as described above; no other regression was found.

acceptanceCriteria: All new tests fail before the relevant patch and pass afterward (recorded: 15 of 23 new tests fail on unpatched base).
Invalid model output never produces a confident unsafe result (ESCALATE with FAIL rule remains).
Public-port fallback questions are concrete, not generic.
User-facing page does not expose raw internal failure codes.
Existing Verify behavior and audit diagnostics remain intact (324 total tests pass, verify packs unchanged).

rollback.method: This package only touches its own allowed files and is file-disjoint from Package B. To roll back: `git revert <commit>...` for each of the six commits (reverse order), or `git checkout 542d042 -- <allowed files>` after dropping the six commits. No database, environment or deployment state is touched.
